Starlink saves lives

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: DogeDesigner (@cb_doge); megjelent: 2026-11-05T13:30:34+00:00; link: https://x.com/cb_doge/status/2118335164019548524; média: videó, 10 másodperc]
BREAKING: Starlink just brought high-speed internet to a clinic serving 10 remote islands in Indonesia. 🇮🇩

Pangkep’s local government equipped Sailus Health Center with Starlink, helping staff send patient referrals online and coordinate care across the islands.
